ORDINANCE I OF 2010
ORDINANCE I OF 2010
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2010
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan
Local Government Ordinance 2001 (XVIII of 2001)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
6th April, 2010]
No. Legis:1-122/Law/2000-XIV, dated 6-4-2010.----The following
Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on 6th
April. 2010, is hereby published for general information;
Preamble.---Whereas, it
is expedient further to amend the Balochistan Local
Government Ordinance, 2001 (XVIII of 2001).
And whereas, the
Provincial Assembly is not in sessions and the Governor is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now therefore, in
exercise of powers conferred by Article 128(1) of the Constitution of Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, 1973 the Governor is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Substitution of the words "District Coordination Officer" by the words "Deputy Commissioner" in Ordinance No.XVIII of 2001

2001 (XVIII of 2001)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary,

No.
Legis:1-122/Law/2000-XIV, dated 6-4-2010.----The following Ordinance made by

information;
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the
Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 2001 (XVIII of 2001).
And whereas, the
Provincial Assembly is not in sessions and the Governor is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now therefore, in
exercise of powers conferred by Article 128(1) of the Constitution of Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, 1973 the Governor is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:--
2. Substitution
of the words "District Coordination Officer" by the words
"Deputy Commissioner" in Ordinance No.XVIII of 2001.--In the Balochistan Local Government Ordinance
2001 (Ordinance No.XVIII of 2001), hereinafter referred to as the said
Ordinance, the words "District Coordination Officer" where
ever occurring shall be substituted by the words "Deputy
Commissioner".
